title: Measuring wavelength with a double slit
stem: Monochromatic laser light passes through a double slit of separation 0.40 mm. The fringe spacing s on a screen is measured for different slit-to-screen distances D. For each D, the distance across ten fringe spacings is measured and divided by ten.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Explain why the distance across ten fringe spacings was measured rather than a single spacing.
markscheme: the absolute uncertainty of the ruler is spread over ten spacings
so the percentage uncertainty in s is reduced (by a factor of about 10)

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Determine the gradient of a graph of s against D.
parts.notes: Penalize failure to convert mm to m only once.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Calculate the wavelength of the laser light.

parts.label: d
parts.prompt: The red laser is replaced by a blue laser. Predict, with a reason, the change in the gradient of the graph.
markscheme: blue light has a shorter wavelength and gradient = λ/d (d unchanged)
